skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Tested One
skins.content: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Tested One. Ayerscarpe's attire while upgrading the Rim Billiton Weapon Distribution Center weapons system. He needs to infiltrate a Catastrophe area together with his friends, and heist an important piece of data back before the Columbians.
skins.usage: One of Ayerscarpe's outfits for crucial moments.
skins.quote: 'And Leon's armed like a weaponized tin can now. Fine, at least we all know what we're doing.'
